title: A reroll after a blocking evaluation does not count an accounted unadmitted change as new evidence
outcome: A reroll after a blocking evaluation does not count an accounted unadmitted change as new evidence
acceptance: an accounted unadmitted source change recorded after a blocking evaluation's cut counts as new evidence for a later evaluation's replacement, whatever revision it reports, as it already voids the blocking evaluation (test)
the refusal that names no new evidence never appears while the blocking evaluation reads stale for that change (test)

completion.summary: Landed in 0d6eb26: a reroll counts an accounted unadmitted source change as new evidence whatever revision it reports.
